records.footnote: Data on adult population refer to the total population in the reporting jurisdiction of individuals 15 years old and above and are published in the World Development Indicators. Data are used for SDG 8.10.1 '(a) Number of commercial bank branches per 100,000 adults and (b) number of automated teller machines (ATMs) per 100,000 adults'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 8.10.1.
